chapters.title: Reconnect to the Masculine or Feminine Within You: The Law of Gender Rigidity

chapterBreakdown.gentle: The chapter on gender rigidity stays useful because it names a pattern people often feel before they can explain it. This law argues that rigid gender performance narrows people by forcing assertive and receptive capacities into hostile camps instead of letting a fuller range of human traits become available. The pressure becomes visible through overperformance. Toughness can turn theatrical. Receptivity can turn manipulative. Seductiveness, distance, dominance, or compliance can all become masks that hide a more divided interior. The law asks the reader to see these performances as compensation rather than essence. The practical move is to integrate the disowned side. Develop the assertive trait you outsource, the receptive trait you mock, the emotional range you learned to hide, or the steadiness you learned to gender incorrectly. The aim is not confusion. It is human breadth. The chapter is about range, not stereotype recycling. That softer honesty is already a practical advantage.
